answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 36847 Country: India Title: One day I went to mosque there I listened a lecture on Islam, then there I offered Isha prayer and sat for a while then I felt for urine so I went to toilet and maturated Question: My question is as follows: One day I went to mosque there I listened a lecture on Islam, then there I offered Isha prayer and sat for a while then I felt for urine so I went to toilet and maturated. After that I entered the mosque without wudhu as I thought I have performed salah and was about to go. So I sat for few minutes and there started ijtimai dua not of salah but of the gathering that was there to listen lecture. So I too performed dua. So can I perform dua as in above situation as I did not perform wudhu before that? Answer ID: 36847 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 246/191/B=1433) Wudhu is not a condition for dua (supplication). You can supplicate without wudhu as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
